Usage: hm db <snapshot|list|restore|remove|clear|freeze|templates|clone|drop> [options]
Description: Named copies of this project's database
Options:
   [-|--name=<name>] Name for the snapshot or template (default: the date, or 'base')
   [-|--force]      Overwrite what already exists, or skip the confirmation
   [-|--all]        With clear: every project's snapshots, not just this one's
   [-|--dry-run]    With restore: say which database would be replaced, and by which copy, and restore nothing
Arguments:
   <<subcommand>>  snapshot, list, restore, remove or clear for dumps; freeze, templates, clone or drop for data directory templates
   <<name>>        The snapshot, or the template as [<project>/]<name>
